# FLEET by Vector Brain

> FLEET is an AI Android automation platform: you describe a task in plain words and an AI agent carries it out on real Android phones, from one phone to a fleet of up to 1,000. Made by Vector AI Agent (support@vectoragent.in). Free to use. A user writes a task in plain words; an AI model (the user's own API key) reads each phone's screen through the Vector companion app (Android Accessibility) and does the taps, across one phone or a whole fleet, watched live from the dashboard at https://app.vectoragent.in.

Key facts:

- Phones: Android 10 or newer, any brand. No root, no ADB, no USB cable. Each phone runs the Vector app and is paired with a 6-character code from the dashboard (valid 10 minutes).
- AI: bring your own key. Supported providers: OpenAI, Google Gemini, Anthropic, DeepSeek, Groq, OpenRouter, and any OpenAI-compatible API at a public address. Keys are stored encrypted (AES-256-GCM). An optional backup model takes over on rate limits.
- Scale: up to 1,000 phones in one fleet.
- Mission Control: a chat that starts missions on phones named with @phone, #tag, "all phones" or "on N phones"; up to 50 phones per mission; timed runs up to 12 hours; confirmation required for more than 5 phones or 10+ minutes; pause, resume, stop; automatic retries (3 tries) for temporary failures; an answer card summarising what each phone reported; file sending to many phones (up to 100 MB).
- Proxy lanes: phones sharing one proxy form a lane with a "phones at once" limit. FLEET rotates the lane's IP by calling the provider's rotation URL after every N tasks; it does not install proxies on phones.
- Network info: each phone reports public, direct and WebRTC IPs, DNS, language, region, SIM country, timezone and clock; mismatches are flagged as alerts.
- Limits: no silent app installs, no unlocking PIN/pattern lock screens, flows replay fixed screen positions without typed text, runs can fail and always report a reason. Acceptable use: the user's own phones and accounts only; no bulk account creation, fake identities, fake engagement or reviews, CAPTCHA solving, or hacking.

- [How it works](https://app.vectoragent.in/how-it-works): the Vector app, the AI model and the check after every action
- [Android fleet automation](https://app.vectoragent.in/android-fleet-automation): one instruction across many phones
- [Phone farm automation](https://app.vectoragent.in/phone-farm-automation): running your own phone farm, network checks and proxy lanes
- [AI mobile app testing](https://app.vectoragent.in/use-cases/mobile-app-testing): the same check on every Android model
- [FLEET vs Appium](https://app.vectoragent.in/compare/appium): plain-language AI agent vs test scripts
- [Full documentation as plain text](https://app.vectoragent.in/llms-full.txt): the complete docs in one Markdown file
